title.zh: 合成器安全与呈现链路推进

summary.en: This week's work advanced the compositor toward a safer, more direct presentation path: shared GPU mailbox transport, owned window surfaces, and Linux sandboxing all moved forward together.
summary.zh: 本周的工作围绕更安全、更直接的合成器呈现路径推进：共享 GPU mailbox 传输、独占窗口呈现 surface 与 Linux 沙箱同步落地。

en: Added GPU mailbox fencing and mmap-based zero-copy transport.
Added an owned window presentation surface for the compositor.
Added Linux seccomp and Landlock sandboxing for compositor isolation.
zh: 补齐 GPU mailbox fence 与基于 mmap 的零拷贝传输。
为合成器加入独占窗口呈现 surface。
为合成器隔离加入 Linux seccomp 与 Landlock 沙箱。

inProgress.en: Browser product integration, rendering compatibility, and complete DOM/Web API coverage continue as active work.
inProgress.zh: 浏览器产品整合、渲染兼容性，以及完整 DOM/Web API 覆盖仍在持续推进。

title.en: Native DOM bindings gain a live document path
title.zh: 原生 DOM 绑定迈向 live Document 路径

summary.en: The native DOM binding work expanded from read-only surface area into document sharing, tree mutation, node collections, and text content behavior.
summary.zh: 原生 DOM 绑定从只读能力继续扩展到文档共享、树变异、节点集合与 textContent 行为。

en: Added native tree mutation operations and child collections.
Added native textContent and node-value behavior.
Landed the shared live-Document design and cached document refactor.
zh: 加入原生树变异操作与子节点集合。
加入原生 textContent 与 nodeValue 行为。
落地 shared live-Document 设计与缓存文档重构。

inProgress.en: The broader DOM/Web API compatibility effort remains active, with production wiring and behavior coverage continuing in slices.
inProgress.zh: 更完整的 DOM/Web API 兼容性仍在持续推进，生产接线与行为覆盖会继续按切片完成。

title.en: Rendering compatibility adds targeted CSS wins
title.zh: 渲染兼容性取得针对性的 CSS 改进

summary.en: Compatibility work delivered targeted CSS behavior while recording the remaining deeper rendering constraints with explicit evidence.
summary.zh: 兼容性工作落地了针对性的 CSS 行为，同时以明确证据记录仍待解决的深层渲染约束。

en: Implemented CSS overflow-clip-margin across parsing and paint paths.
Canonicalized logical sizing cascade behavior with measured compatibility gains.
Kept legacy product smoke checks free of structural regressions.
zh: 在解析与绘制链路实现 CSS overflow-clip-margin。
规范化逻辑尺寸层叠行为，并取得可测的兼容性收益。
保持 legacy 产品 smoke 检查无结构性回归。

inProgress.en: The remaining compatibility gaps are concentrated in structural and font-metric work rather than small isolated switches.
inProgress.zh: 剩余兼容性缺口集中在结构性与字体度量工作，而不是零散的单点开关。

title.en: Font metrics and rendering evidence narrow the next steps
title.zh: 字体度量与渲染证据进一步收敛下一步方向

summary.en: Rendering investigations improved measurement fidelity and clarified where broad compatibility work is constrained by complex text and metric behavior.
summary.zh: 渲染调研提升了测量一致性，并进一步厘清广泛兼容性工作受复杂文本与度量行为制约的位置。

en: Registered fontdue measurement to align the browser path with rendering expectations.
Confirmed full product smoke coverage for the current fixture set.
Recorded fresh CSS Grid measurements and updated the compatibility evidence.
zh: 注册 fontdue 测量，使浏览器路径与渲染预期保持一致。
确认当前 fixture 集的产品 smoke 全部通过。
记录新的 CSS Grid 测量结果并更新兼容性证据。

inProgress.en: The next compatibility work focuses on text metrics and structural rendering paths that need coordinated, rather than isolated, changes.
inProgress.zh: 下一阶段兼容性工作聚焦于需要协同改动的文本度量与结构性渲染路径。
